responsibility: Declares Xtensa bare-metal ELF driver-only options that are specific to this subtarget rather than the common Xtensa backend. In this file that role is the rdynamic option entry, allowing the Xtensa ELF driver specs in elf.h to recognize and forward dynamic-symbol-export behavior during linking.
same_name_distinction: Unlike elf.h, which implements the bare-metal ELF subtarget through target macros and driver specs, this file is only the option-definition side of the same subtarget, declaring the driver-visible rdynamic switch that elf.h's LINK_SPEC forwards.
